# Archery at the 2012 Summer Olympics – Women's Team

## Event Overview

The women's team archery competition took place at Lord's Cricket Ground in London from July 27-29, 2012. Teams consisted of three archers each, with scores combined.

## Medal Results

| Medal | Country | Athletes |
|-------|---------|----------|
| **Gold** | South Korea | Ki Bo-bae, Lee Sung-jin, Choi Hyeon-ju |
| **Silver** | China | Cheng Ming, Fang Yuting, Xu Jing |
| **Bronze** | Japan | Ren Hayakawa, Miki Kanie, Kaori Kawanaka |

## South Korea's Dominance

South Korea continued their remarkable dominance in women's team archery, winning their seventh consecutive Olympic gold medal in this event (every Games since it was introduced in 1988). They defeated China in the final.

## Competition Format

- Eight teams competed in the knockout rounds
- Teams were seeded based on combined ranking round scores
- Matches used the set system, where teams shot 24 arrows total (8 per archer in each set)
- The team winning a set earned 2 set points; ties earned 1 point each
- First team to 5 set points won the match

## Notable Points

The Korean team set multiple Olympic records during the competition, demonstrating their traditional strength in the sport.
